items.title: Jason Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] It reminds me of the three times I saw Cannonball Adderley years ago. He was a master of that. [INTERVIEWEE] Yup. Great orator. Yup.

ctx.x: Yeah. That’s another thing is, yeah I don’t want to go too deep into it but just being able to relate to the audience outside of just playing. You know when you play a tune, explain what the tune is. Explain the name of it, if it has a story it’s just going to inform them and maybe they’ll imagine it differently when they hear it. So you know I think it would benefit us greatly to have the ability to be able to speak about the music that we make, that we compose. You know we’ve got to able to give a 30-second…
It reminds me of the three times I saw Cannonball Adderley years ago. He was a master of that.
